products.title: XERO Chiron
products.description_html:
An electric off-road motorcycle that unlocks with your phone. 980 Nm at the rear wheel, 120 km/h, 104 kg. Brushed aluminium bodywork over a single-piece frame that carries the pack.

Your steel owner card pairs the machine to you once. After that your iPhone lies flat in the tank pocket, charges while you ride, and is the only thing that wakes it.

Manufacturer figures, not independently certified. Real-world results vary with terrain, rider weight, temperature, tyre choice and setup.

Off-road only — not street legal. Not homologated or registrable for road use in the United States. Sold for use on private land and off-road terrain. Riders must be 18 or over.
